text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a great race, Copano Rickey
returns to the
runners' tunnel while
regaining her breath.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Yeah, I think I got a passing grade. ☆ My running has jumped up a level!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(But if I continue like this, I'll only hit a
wall. If I
want to get past it, I'll have to
think laterally.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(That means I need to elevate my qi flow
to the
same level. The feng shui
approach to this would
be...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Getting the Four Guardians in their
rightful
positions! By arranging
formidable racers who
represent the
Four in the right compass
directions,
we'll resonate and grow together!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That means me, Tarumae, Acute,
and—even
though she doesn't race as
much now she's made
a name for
herself—Falco!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Since Tarumae's missing from her part of
the
formation, there's no way I'll be able
to improve.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she saw the race today. If she
did, I
hope it inspired her to come back.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: But maybe she didn't even see it at all...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In that case, if I want the sparks from my
fire to
reach her... I...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Great running out there, Rickey. I
wonder what
Tarumae made of it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Acute. Yeah, I'm wondering the
same thing. I
have no idea.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you were right, though. Maybe
all we can
do is believe in her for now.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well, maybe that's true for me...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But you have that "feng shui" thing of
yours,
right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Don't you have some kind of mysterious
power
that can help her out?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Acute...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You're right. I do have feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The power to make people smile! And
right now,
Tarumae is really suffering!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui isn't some all-powerful
magic—it can't
make the world bend to
its whims.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: But what it can do is bring everything around you into harmony!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, have you got a minute? It's
about our
next race!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui is telling me that there's a race
I
absolutely have to enter. Can you trust
me on
this?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The qi vein between Tarumae and her
hometown
of Tomakomai has been cut
off.
choice_data_list: いいけど、風水的にって……？
choice_data_list_en: Sure, but what do you mean, 'feng shui-wise'...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If we can't reconnect it, it'll leave
everyone
unhappy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I'll repair the connection!
It's
something only I can do, with feng
shui!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Copano Rickey returns to the
spectator
stands with a look of
determination on her face.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Listen up, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to enter the Mile
Championship Nambu
Hai next!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship Nambu Hai is a
G1 race
in October.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Held at Morioka Racecourse in Iwate, it's
the first
G1 dirt race of the fall-winter
season. In other
words...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you live nearby, come and watch! ☆ In
fact, all
of you from the Tohoku region
should come, if
you can make it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That goes for all of you from Hokkaido,
too! I'll
show you the best race you'll see
all year—that's a
promise!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And I know the other racers there will
feel the
same! I swear it on the Four
Guardians!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her statement is both a message, and an

unspoken challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All for one purpose: to reconnect Hokko
Tarumae
with her fans in Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Tarumae... She might not believe in
feng shui.
But still...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(I'm going to make sure it reaches her! If
I just
believe, I know it will!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I won't let her just fade away. I won't
accept it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
At the Mile Championship Nambu Hai,
I'll make
sure she rises again!
